name: Paradoxical Shuangjie Shi
source:
[i]Paradoxical: Poem of Dual Worlds[/i] is a narrative-driven Galgame that seamlessly blends [b]modern school life[/b] with the [b]rise and fall of an ancient dynasty[/b].

You will step into the shoes of an ordinary high school student, shuttling between two seemingly unrelated eras:
- In the modern world, you share laughs and heartwarming moments with close friends, encounter three young women with distinct personalities, and seek answers within the simple, everyday rhythm of youth.
- In the ancient realm, you converse with scholars and poets, live among the common people, and use modern thinking to alter the course of a dynasty—yet unknowingly stir a storm that will sweep across both worlds.

However, this power to traverse time and space will eventually reveal its price…

As clues from both worlds intertwine and the fates of those you cherish begin to overlap, forgotten memories, altered pasts, and orchestrated encounters all hint at one truth: your very existence is a grand paradox.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4301830]Steam[/url]]
translation:
[i]悖论：双重世界之诗[/i]是一款叙事驱动的Galgame，将[b]现代学校生活[/b]与[b]古代王朝的兴衰[/b]无缝地融合在一起。

你将扮演一名普通高中生，穿梭于两个看似无关的时代：
- 在现代的世界里，你与亲密的朋友分享欢笑和温馨的时刻，邂逅三位性格鲜明的年轻女性，并在简单、日常的青春节奏中寻找答案。
——在远古的国度，你与文人雅士交谈，生活在民间，用现代思维改变王朝的进程，却在不知不觉中掀起一场席卷两个世界的风暴。

然而，这种穿越时空的力量，终究会显露出它的代价……

当两个世界的线索交织在一起，你所珍视的人的命运开始重叠时，被遗忘的记忆、改变的过去和精心策划的遭遇都暗示着一个事实：你的存在本身就是一个巨大的悖论。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4301830]Steam[/url]]
